narrative.overview: Every record in this console is a white card laid on a cool, quiet page, read under a navy margin. Each card says what it is in navy ink, and the one figure a person opened it for — the premium a life pays, what a policy assures, what a deposit is worth at maturity — is lit in teal. Nothing else is lit. Adopted on 2026-10-21 from the tinezz-insurance-console mockup in place of the achromatic Ledger, it keeps the Ledger's working doctrine — tabular figures, six status buckets, contrast floors, the record rail, confirmations with real values, receipts of returned facts — and changes the material. Render only what the platform can prove still governs: the lit figure is always a value the server returned.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mist page, white cards on a soft two-layer shadow, a navy sidebar island
One teal with two meanings: act here, and this is the answer
Six status hues, unchanged, are the only other colour
Manrope for every working line and every number, tabular; Sora only for heading words
A compressed, functional type scale; density over display
Light and dark defined for every token; the sidebar is navy in both

rules.name: The Two Meanings Rule
rules.body: Teal means act here or this is the answer, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Six Buckets Rule
rules.body: Six status buckets are the complete status vocabulary.

rules.name: The Both Themes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token in :root and .dark; islands redefine token names and use raw tokens inside.

rules.name: The Manrope Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is Manrope with tabular figures; Sora is for heading words.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: tabular-nums is set on body and never overridden.

rules.name: The Two-Peaks Rule
rules.body: At most two sizes above Title on a screen: the page headline and the lit figure.

rules.name: The Card Rule
rules.body: A page-level box is a card; a box inside a card is flat.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: The only gradient is the figures band, and it holds figures, never controls.

rules.name: The Three Lines Rule
rules.body: Only a box's outline, the rule between table rows, and a form section's rule.

dos: Do put every page-level box on a card (16px, Card White, hairline, Card shadow) and keep what is inside it flat.
Do set every figure in Manrope with tabular figures, right-aligned in a column.
Do lead a record with the figure it exists for, on the figures band, and only a figure the server returned.
Do make the one act on a screen the Primary teal button, and every form's submit Primary.
Do define every colour in :root and .dark, and inside an island use the raw token, not the --color-* alias.
Do put a full-page form in FormLayout, and mark its sections with data-outline (or Panel outline).
Do size a figure inside a card with the Figure tier, so it never leaves the card.
Do map a new enum onto one of the six status buckets.
Do render an absent value as an em dash in Subtle Ink.
Do keep the 3:1 Input Edge on every field and the 2px teal focus ring on every control.
Do check white text on any teal at 4.5:1 — a lighter teal measured 3.59:1 on the LP mark.
donts: Don't use teal for a status, a section, a chart series or decoration. It means act here or this is the answer.
Don't put a shadow on a box inside a card, or a gradient anywhere but the figures band.
Don't set a number in Sora, or any text below 12px.
Don't hard-code a colour in a component; the hashed avatar hue is the only exception.
Don't add a seventh status bucket, or colour a delta green or red.
Don't sum, average or difference in the browser to make a figure look complete.
Don't put a mutating action in the slide-over or the record rail.
Don't emphasise more than one panel, or emphasise with a tint.
Don't introduce a tenant name, switcher or per-insurer branding; the teal is the platform's.
Don't load a font from a third party; both faces are self-hosted.
